coverage: Verified candidate file hashes against packet values (rc_filter.kicad_pcb f8264d95..., rc_filter.kicad_sch ecc56a68...).

Reviewed packet ERC/DRC/netlist/geometry artifacts (work/erc/erc.json, work/drc/drc.json, work/netlist/design.xml, work/geometry/geometry.json) and cross-checked net membership (/IN: J1.1,R1.1; /OUT: C1.1,J1.2,R1.2; GND: C1.2,J1.3) against pad nets in inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb.

Independent pad/track endpoint coincidence arithmetic for all 7 pads and 5 segments, including the mid-segment T-junction at (107.5,100) on the R1.2->C1.1 /OUT track (review-work/physical/experiments/geom_check.py, geom_check_output.txt).

Point-in-polygon analysis of the saved B.Cu GND filled_polygon (186 vertices): GND via (113,100) inside fill; J1.3 connected by 4 diagonal thermal spokes; single filled polygon implies one connected copper region, so the GND return path C1.2 -> F.Cu track -> via -> B.Cu zone -> J1.3 is intact as saved (review-work/physical/experiments/zone_check.py, zone_check_output.txt).
Board outline containment: all pads/tracks/via inside Edge.Cuts rectangle (96..116, 96..108) per inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_pcb; zone outline inset 0.5 mm from edge.

Electrical criterion checked two ways: analytic v(1ms)=1-exp(-1)=0.63212 V with tau=RC=1.000 ms (window equivalent tau 0.9525..1.0335 ms), and ngspice-42 transient giving 0.6319 V at 1 ms (review-work/physical/experiments/rc_step.cir, rc_step_ngspice.log, geom_check_output.txt). Both inside the required 0.62..0.65 V window.
Schematic label/wire placement sanity-checked against the exported netlist in inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_sch (IN/OUT/GND label geometry consistent with net membership).
limitations: Zone fill evaluated exactly as saved in the candidate board file; no refill pass was possible (candidate read-only), matching the packet's declared limitation.
ngspice stimulus used a 1 us PWL ramp approximating the ideal step; the analytic closed form was used as the primary pass/fail evidence.

No current-carrying or thermal qualification performed: signal current is ~100 uA at 1 V through 10 kOhm and the scope forbids imposing unstated ratings; track widths were not treated as evidence of ampacity.
Via drill 0.3 mm with 0.15 mm annular ring and 0.25 mm zone min thickness were not checked against any specific fabricator capability since none is declared in the packet.
Solder mask, paste, silkscreen and assembly aspects reviewed only via the packet's KiCad DRC result (0 violations); no gerber-level plot inspection performed.
Component tolerance sensitivity not analyzed: scope specifies ideal passive components (nominal 0.632 V has margin 0.012 V to the lower bound and 0.018 V to the upper bound).
